name: footer-wordmark
title: Wordmark footer
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: Footer links and a note above the site name set across the full width, sized from its length, with an inverse or plain tone.

meta.useWhen: The name is short and the rest of the site is quiet, so the footer can be the one expressive brand moment.
meta.avoidWhen: The header already shows a large wordmark, or the name runs past about sixteen characters. A repeated giant wordmark reads as filler.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/FooterWordmark.astro. Use a short name; tune fit if the face is unusually wide.
